## Problem

Describe the task you cannot currently complete and who needs the result.

## Proposed behavior

Give a concrete input and expected output or CLI example. Use synthetic data and remove personal or confidential details.

## Scientific basis

For scientific or regulatory changes, identify the official source, exact standard title and edition, units, assumptions, and applicable jurisdiction. Link to sources rather than reproducing copyrighted standards or TLV tables.

## Acceptance criteria

Explain how the result can be independently checked, including important boundary cases.

## Alternatives

Describe any current workaround and why the proposed behavior would help.
